verdict.rationale: CodeRabbit reviews run automatically and autonomously in the background whenever PRs are opened or updated, with configurable auto-review rules (branch scoping, draft skipping, pause-after-N-commits) and one-click agentic actions that autonomously fix findings, resolve conflicts, or generate tests. It also offers a Slack agent for autonomous investigation and self-hosted deployment for running the review agent continuously in your own infra. missing for 10: independent hands-on confirmation of background automation reliability at scale, and evidence of general-purpose scheduled or triggered automation beyond PR-event-driven workflows.
